init.title: Smart Weather Protection
init.description:
## Rain Hold Formula

`HA extra hold = base + floor(precipitation ÷ factor) × step`

The mower's built-in rain delay (1–3 h, set via the Rain Delay entity) runs in parallel. HA only extends protection *beyond* what the hardware can do.

**Examples** with defaults (base=0 h, factor=5 mm, step=1 h, max=24 h):

| Precipitation | HA extra hold | Hardware (3 h) | Total |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 mm | floor(5÷5)×1 = **1 h** | 3 h | 4 h |
| 20 mm | floor(20÷5)×1 = **4 h** | 3 h | 7 h |
| 50 mm | floor(50÷5)×1 = **10 h** | 3 h | 13 h |

**Tip:** Set base > 0 only if the mower's built-in rain sensor is disabled.

---

data.rain_hold_base_hours: Base hold (hours) — added regardless of rain amount; 0 = let hardware handle it
data.rain_factor_mm: Factor (mm per step) — lower value = longer hold for light rain
data.rain_hold_step_hours: Step size (hours per factor block) — higher value = steeper curve
data.rain_hold_max_hours: Maximum HA-managed hold (hours) — hardware hold adds on top
data.forecast_hours_ahead: Forecast look-ahead (hours, 1–12) — block mowing if rain is forecast within this window
data.max_temperature: Max mowing temperature (°C) — mower docks above this threshold
data.auto_dock_unsafe: Auto-dock mower when conditions are unsafe
